title: Context is rebuilt from the log, never remembered
purpose: Kill a worker in the middle of a slow model call and see that the retry sends the same prompt. Then run the same task once without and once with compaction, and rebuild every prompt of both runs from the database to show that each one can be reproduced exactly.

steps.display: agentctl model-fault --latency 30   # every model call now takes 30 seconds
agentctl status s-37ec255f   # step 0's model call is in flight
kubectl -n agent-platform delete pod worker-v1-79d5c699b8-cs4lb --grace-period=0 --force   # the worker dies while waiting for the model
steps.output: pod "worker-v1-79d5c699b8-cs4lb" force deleted from agent-platform namespace

steps.display: agentctl model-fault --latency 0   # the provider answers quickly again
agentctl calls s-37ec255f   # step 0 appears twice, with the same prompt hash

checks.description: the run carried on after the worker's death
checks.because: Another worker took over the model-call activity.

checks.description: the interrupted model call was made a second time, with an identical prompt
checks.because: The prompt is rebuilt from the session database, so the second worker, which remembered nothing, built the same one. This call is the one cost of a worker dying mid-call: it is paid for twice.

checks.description: the context log holds one answer for step 0, not two
checks.because: Writing an entry is idempotent: the second attempt's write changed nothing.

checks.description: compaction happened, and the compacted run finished the same job
checks.because: The scripted model reads its position from the summary exactly as it would from the full log, so the outcome is identical.

checks.description: the compacted prompt was smaller, and each summary cost exactly one model call
checks.because: A compaction is an activity: it is stored once and recorded in the history, so a replay reuses it and does not ask the model for another.

checks.description: without compaction: every prompt rebuilds to exactly the hash recorded when it was sent
checks.because: The prompt is a pure function of the stored log and summaries, which are append-only.

checks.description: with compaction: every prompt rebuilds to exactly the hash recorded when it was sent
